title: 第16章 歪打正着
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
带着警告意味的话语在室内回荡。

    白从义盯着对面，眸光深邃，好似要洞彻人的内心。

    苏牧心里咯噔一下，下意识以为是自己的来历背景出了问题，从而导致了今日的意外。

    因为觉醒宿慧，他从小就思想成熟，拥有前世三十多岁成年人的思维。

    担心在外修行与人结仇而牵连到家中，他未雨绸缪，做了万全准备，编造了一个孤儿的身世背景来投拜宗门。

    但此事，在整个青云宗只有楚阳一人知道。

    而他对楚阳有相当的信任基础，从小一起长大，虽是主仆关系，却犹如亲兄弟。

    念头一闪而过，苏牧随即反应过来，这应该是审讯手段，想要诈自己。

    他确信自己编造的身世没有漏洞，很难查证，却无法确定执法殿会不会真的去查，是否有自己认知外的手段找到一些蛛丝马迹。

    但既然都是赌，便无需考虑，即便自己败露身死，也好过连累家人一起遭劫。

    是以，苏牧愣了愣，眨眼狐疑道：“弟子确为孤儿。”

    顿了顿，他一脸正色道：“回禀长老，求仙拜宗，不敢对身份有丝毫隐瞒和扯谎！”

    “弟子祖籍应该是凉州登城一带，从小被贼人捉去山上，教习武道，训练培养成匪寇……直到十三岁才侥幸逃脱。”

    “因被捉时年龄太小，大概只有三、四岁，对家中一应情况完全记不得了。”

    “但那伙土匪，弟子却记得清清楚楚，叫‘黑山寨’，位于登城丘县北面的黑木崖，大当家名叫张峰，武道达至‘锐凡境’，不出意外，现在应该还活着，长老可以派人去查证。”

    过了几十年了，白从义心知对方料定不好查，似笑非笑道：“有点意思，长在土匪窝，十三岁你便达到‘凝骨境’巅峰？”

    武道境界分为锻体、凝骨、锐凡、胎息、通玄……其中锻体是入门，凝骨对应修士的炼气期，凝骨巅峰相当于炼气后期修士。

    不过，在武道没落、仙道盛行的天玄大陆，武者修到锐凡境已是佼佼，突破到胎息的则少之又少，为武道界的大拿。

    苏牧十三岁达到凝骨巅峰，称得上武道天才，天赋异禀。

    这一点他隐瞒不了，当初拜宗检测灵根时，被探查出了体内的真气，记录在档案中，只不过外人少有人知道罢了。

    苏牧露出一丝苦笑，解释道：“弟子灵根资质低劣，倒是在武道上有些许天资，可惜武道于寿元无多益处，不然就练武了，想来当年的贼人也是捏过我的根骨，觉得是个武道苗子，才掳到土匪窝去，那匪首张峰亲自教导我……”

    白从义不置可否，换了个话题道：“你在炼气五层停留十五年之久，一朝突破，却是不容易。”

    苏牧自然明白对方要表达的意思，面露一丝感慨道：“多亏了齐长老，对我青睐有加，悉心栽培，鼎力相助，赠与诸多资源，否则，弟子怕是这辈子都不可能再前进一步。”

    白从义目光一闪问：“齐长老？”
content_en:
Warning words echoed in the room.

    Bai Congyi stared at the opposite side, his eyes were deep, as if he wanted to penetrate people's hearts.

    Su Mu's heart skipped a beat, and he subconsciously thought that something was wrong with his background, which led to today's accident.

    Because of his awakening of Su Hui, he has been mature in thinking since he was a child and has the thinking of an adult in his thirties in his previous life.

    Worried about making enemies while practicing outside and involving others at home, he took precautions and made complete preparations. He fabricated the life background of an orphan to worship the sect.

    But Chu Yang was the only one in the entire Qingyun Sect who knew about this matter.

    And he has a considerable foundation of trust in Chu Yang. They grew up together. Although they have a master-servant relationship, they are like brothers.

    The thought flashed through his mind, and Su Mu immediately realized that this was probably an interrogation method to deceive him.

    He was convinced that there were no loopholes in his fabricated life experience and would be difficult to verify, but he was not sure whether the Law Enforcement Hall would actually investigate or whether there would be some clues found by means beyond his own knowledge.

    But since it was all gambling, there was no need to think about it. Even if he was exposed and died, it would be better than dragging his family along with him.

    Therefore, Su Mu was stunned, blinked and said suspiciously: "This disciple is indeed an orphan."

    After a pause, he said with a serious face: "Replying to the elders, I seek immortality and worship my sect. I dare not hide or lie about my identity at all!"

    "The disciple's ancestral home should be in the Dengcheng area of Liangzhou. He was captured by thieves and taken to the mountains when he was a child. He was taught martial arts and trained to become a bandit... until he was thirteen years old and managed to escape."

    "Because he was too young when he was caught, probably only three or four years old, he has no memory of anything going on at home."

    "But the disciple remembers that group of bandits clearly. They are called 'Black Mountain Village'. They are located in Heimu Cliff in the north of Dengchengqiu County. The leader's name is Zhang Feng. His martial arts has reached the 'Rui Fan Realm'. As expected, he should still be alive now. The elder can send someone to check."

    Decades later, Bai Congyi knew that it was difficult to check the opponent's ingredients, and said with a half-smile: "It's interesting. You grew up in a bandit's den, and you reached the peak of the 'Bone Condensation Realm' at the age of thirteen?"

    The realm of martial arts is divided into body training, bone condensation, Ruifan, fetal breath, and Tongxuan... Among them, body training is the entry level, bone condensation corresponds to the monk's Qi refining period, and the peak bone condensation is equivalent to the monk in the later stage of Qi refining.

    However, in the Tianxuan Continent where martial arts declined and immortality prevailed, warriors who had reached the Ruifan realm were already outstanding, but those who had broken through to fetal breath were very few and became the masters in the martial arts world.

    Su Mu reached the peak of bone condensation at the age of thirteen and was considered a martial arts genius with extraordinary talent.

    He couldn't hide this. When he worshiped the sect to test his spiritual roots, the true energy in his body was detected and recorded in the files, but few outsiders knew about it.

    Su Mu showed a wry smile and explained: "My disciple's spiritual talent is low, but he has some talent in martial arts. Unfortunately, martial arts does not have much benefit to Shouyuan, otherwise he would practice martial arts. I think the thieves pinched my bones back then and thought I was a martial arts seedling, so they kidnapped me to a bandit's den. The bandit Zhang Feng taught me personally..."

    Bai Congyi was noncommittal and changed the subject: "You have stayed at the fifth level of Qi Refining for fifteen years, but it is not easy to break through."

    Su Mu naturally understood what the other party wanted to express, and said with a hint of emotion: "Thanks to Elder Qi for favoring me, cultivating me with all his care, helping me with great efforts, and giving me many resources. Otherwise, I am afraid that this disciple will not be able to make any further progress in this life."

    Bai Congyi's eyes flashed and he asked: "Elder Qi?"
